descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-06 tests 1, 3; TFA-94514 req 1, 7 · “Trigger a duplicate-detection prompt, confirm shown/accepted/rejected are all logged”. Mixed: stated part — Scan adds tagged scan, duplicate prompt shown/accepted/rejected for scans in both modes, photo-capture AI call logs provider time; our part — Closing the scan sheet without a choice, and no photo names in rows (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S04 Scan add and its duplicate prompt through the real scan screens, both contexts: tagged scan, one row per created patient, choice -> rows

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident; synthetic photos listing 'QA Scan …' names plus the fixture patient's or resident's name and room; T0 recorded

When R1 Hospital: Scan Patient List with qa-census-oat06.png, add the three new rows and, for the row matching {hospitalPatient}, keep the existing patient. R2 Hospital: scan qa-census-oat06-dup.png ({hospitalPatient} only) and choose to add a new patient anyway. …

Then R1: 3 patient_added scan_census hospital; duplicate_prompt_shown + duplicate_prompt_accepted (addMethod scan_census, hospital); no extra chart. R2: shown + rejected (scan_census, hospital), patient_added +1, two charts with the fixture name. R3: shown only. R4: 2 patient_added scan_census nursing_home; scan_census_completed createdCount 2, linkedCount 1; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 1 + Test 3 and TFA-94514 AC 1 / TFA-92580 AC 7 in both contexts (3.3; TC-09's '6 already known, 2 new' prompt in Nursing Home). Judged from the post-run read: per row exactly one shown row with the right careSetting and addMethod scan_census and, where a choice was made, exactly one outcome row; the patient_added counts. …

Detail:

Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s04-scan.spec.ts (2 tests, each a brand-new @roundai.test physician). ai/vision:scanCensusSheet is answered at the Convex socket with the rows the matrix's photos list (Hospital: QA Scan Avery / Brook / Cole plus the existing chart's name and room; Nursing Home: QA Scan Dana / Ellis plus the existing resident's name); the photo itself is a neutral fixture image, so OCR quality (TFA-92580 AC 2/AC 6, B01) is not judged. Rows read from patientActivityEvents with the local admin key. Judged 14/14: R1 Hospital: 3 patient_added (addMethod scan_census, careSetting hospital); exactly one duplicate_prompt_shown and one duplicate_prompt_accepted with the same promptId (scan_census, hospital); no rejected row; still one chart with the fixture name. R2: one shown + one rejected (same promptId, scan_census, hospital), patient_added +1, two charts with the fixture name. R4 Nursing Home: 2 patient_added (scan_census, nursing_home); one scan_census_completed with createdCount 2, linkedCount 1 (selectedCount 3); one shown + one accepted (nursing_home, scan_census); the matched resident is not counted as an add and no copy is made. R5: one shown + one rejected (nursing_home, scan_census), patient_added +1, two residents with the name. U15: no row holds a scanned name, room or unit (19 rows checked). Recorded only (Q5): closing the Hospital scan sheet (X) before confirming shows no prompt and writes nothing; the Hospital prompt has no close or 'decide later' control, so leaving it without a choice (here a reload) writes duplicate_prompt_shown only; Nursing Home 'Decide later' then closing the sheet writes shown only and adds nothing. Recorded: a Hospital scan writes no scan_census_completed row (only Nursing Home does); R5's scan_census_completed has createdCount 1, linkedCount 0. Part left: U13 for the vision call (aiCallLog providerMs > 0 and <= durationMs, model, ai_disclosure provider_ms) needs a live scanCensusSheet call; locally the call is answered in the browser, so no aiCallLog row exists (verified: 0 vision rows for the account), and on dev it is blocked by B01.
